Longest Palindromic Signal

You are analyzing electromagnetic signals received from deep space. The signal is encoded as a string of characters. Scientists are particularly interested in the longest palindromic segment within the signal, as these appear to carry the most coherent information.

Given a string S, find the length of the longest palindromic substring.
explanation: Manacher's Algorithm solves this in O(N) time. Transform the string to insert special characters between each character (and at boundaries) to handle even-length palindromes uniformly. Maintain a rightmost palindrome's center C and right edge R. For each position i, use the mirror palindrome's length as a starting value for P[i], then expand. When the palindrome at i extends past R, update C and R. The answer is max(P).
